comparisonCandidates.name: Meizu figurative M
comparisonCandidates.goodsSummary: Recorded computer software, operating programs, game programs, downloadable music and ringtones, portable media players, headphones, computers, telecommunications apparatus and other electronics.
comparisonCandidates.verification: Registration status, owner, dates, renewal and goods were directly read in EUIPO eSearch, in addition to TMview. Full legal history and current enforcement/use not investigated.
comparisonCandidates.visualObservation: Meizu is a wide solid rectangular M-like shape with two narrow straight white channels and an unbroken top. MixRelay has a square silhouette, equal straight stem/gap modules, lighter top and a diagonal opening plus lower right return. Both share the connected-top, three-stem, two-channel construction.
comparisonCandidates.assessment: Closest verified structural comparison in this review. Relevant overlapping software/audio goods warrant formal comparison. No infringement or non-infringement finding.

comparisonCandidates.name: MIDIRack
comparisonCandidates.field: Music/MIDI software for iPad and iPhone
comparisonCandidates.visualObservation: Orange/blue outlined MR; a V-shaped M crown, curved R bowl, multiple separated inner uprights, and an exposed sloping leg. Letter initials and audio field coincide, but complete construction differs visibly from the filled square MixRelay mark.
comparisonCandidates.assessment: Not identical; actual trademark registrations, territory and confusion not established.

comparisonCandidates.name: Greenlines Studios Monogram MR Logo Design
comparisonCandidates.visualObservation: Literal capital M and R with a steep slash between them, pointed M valley and a curved R bowl. Different from MixRelay’s connected flat crown, equal modules and shallow right-side cut.
comparisonCandidates.assessment: Not identical; source listing is evidence of public design availability, not a verified trademark right or legal clearance.

limits: TMview image search retrieves candidates; its ranks and counts do not measure legal risk. Many retrieved marks differed substantially, limiting recall confidence.
Only the first page of classes 9 and 42 and the upper all-class gallery were visually inspected; remaining records and unavailable images were not cleared.
TMview contains participating-office data; this is not an exhaustive worldwide search. No blanket worldwide safety finding is possible from this work.

Only Meizu EUTM 012350501 was directly verified against its native register in this turn. Other countries, unregistered use, copyrights, phonetic/transliteration variants and full legal histories were not comprehensively reviewed.
WIPO database was not automatically queried, consistent with its automated-query restriction. Its official public guidance was read.
Earlier MixRelay / Mix Relay zero-result name searches do not clear the symbol and were not rerun in this turn.
